summary: Today's briefing features a mixed regulatory and market environment, driven by state actions following Supreme Court directions on transport services alongside key festive retail performance metrics. Corporate developments include strategic revenue targets at ABFRL and private equity bidding for FMCG assets.

bullets.text: Karnataka will frame bike taxi regulations after consulting its Advocate General following a Supreme Court directive, transport minister Byrathi Suresh announced.
Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail expects its luxury segment to contribute 30-33% of total revenue within 4-5 years, up from 20%.
A timing shift in Flipkart’s festive sale reduced Walmart’s third-quarter topline growth by 100 basis points.
India’s festive season smartphone sales fell 22% year-on-year, with Apple recording a double-digit decline.
ChrysCapital, Investcorp, and Sofina are the three PE funds in the final race to acquire a minority stake in Hocco Ice Cream.
